q: The Periodic Table was devised in 1869 by the Russian chemist ____.
e: The Periodic Table was devised in 1869 by the Russian chemist Dmitri Mendeleev. Dmitri Mendeleev is the idea that completes this fact.

q: His Periodic Table was based on the chemical and physical properties of the 63 elements that had been discovered at that ____.
e: His Periodic Table was based on the chemical and physical properties of the 63 elements that had been discovered at that time. Time is the idea that completes this fact.

q: In the modern Periodic Table the 118 known elements are arranged in order of increasing ____ number.
e: In the modern Periodic Table the 118 known elements are arranged in order of increasing atomic number. Atomic number Z is the number of protons in the nucleus, and it identifies the element.

q: There are 18 vertical columns and 7 horizontal rows in the Periodic ____.
e: There are 18 vertical columns and 7 horizontal rows in the Periodic Table. The periodic table arranges elements by atomic number so similar properties sit in groups.

q: The vertical columns are called ____.
e: The vertical columns are called groups. Groups is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The horizontal rows are called ____.
e: The horizontal rows are called periods. Periods is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Those elements with similar chemical properties are found in the same columns or ____.
e: Those elements with similar chemical properties are found in the same columns or groups. Groups is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Group I elements (except hydrogen) are called the ____ metals.
e: Group I elements (except hydrogen) are called the alkali metals. An alkali is a soluble base that produces OH- ions in water.

q: Group II elements are called the alkaline ____ metals.
e: Group II elements are called the alkaline earth metals. Earth is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Group VII elements are called the ____.
e: Group VII elements are called the halogens. Halogens is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Group 0 elements are known as the noble gases or ____ gases.
e: Group 0 elements are known as the noble gases or inert gases. Inert is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Groups I and II consist of ____-block elements.
e: Groups I and II consist of s-block elements. S is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Groups III, IV, V, VI, VII and group 0 consist of ____-block elements.
e: Groups III, IV, V, VI, VII and group 0 consist of p-block elements. P is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Transition elements are ____-block elements.
e: Transition elements are d-block elements. D is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Inner transition elements (lanthanides and actinides series), also known as rare earth elements are the ____-block elements.
e: Inner transition elements (lanthanides and actinides series), also known as rare earth elements are the f-block elements. F is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Lithium is used to make batteries that power electronic devices like digital ____.
e: Lithium is used to make batteries that power electronic devices like digital cameras. Cameras is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Sodium vapour lamps give off yellow-orange light and are often used in street ____.
e: Sodium vapour lamps give off yellow-orange light and are often used in street lamps. Lamps is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Fluoride is used in toothpaste to help reduce dental ____.
e: Fluoride is used in toothpaste to help reduce dental decay. Decay is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Chlorine is used in household bleach to kill bacteria, to whiten clothes, and to clean swimming ____.
e: Chlorine is used in household bleach to kill bacteria, to whiten clothes, and to clean swimming pool. Pool is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Bromine is used as a fire ____.
e: Bromine is used as a fire retardant. Retardant is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Iodine is used in photographic ____.
e: Iodine is used in photographic reproduction. Reproduction makes a new generation so the species can continue.

q: The metalloid silicon is used to make silicon ____.
e: The metalloid silicon is used to make silicon chips. Chips is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Helium is used for filling weather or advertisement balloons and ____.
e: Helium is used for filling weather or advertisement balloons and airships. Airships is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Neon is used in making light and advertising ____.
e: Neon is used in making light and advertising signs. Signs is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Argon is used to fill tungsten bulbs to provide an inert (unreactive) atmosphere that prevents ____ of the filament.
e: Argon is used to fill tungsten bulbs to provide an inert (unreactive) atmosphere that prevents oxidation of the filament. Oxidation is the idea that completes this fact.
